template.name: Precision Trading Strategy: Golden Edge
template.entry_long: crossabove(ema(close,{p0}),ema(close,{p1})) and rsi(close,{p2}) > {p0} and roc(ema(close,9),1) > {p1} and atr(high,low,close,14) > sma(atr(high,low,close,14),50)
template.notes: The documented long rule keeps the fast/slow EMA cross, RSI above 55 and rising trend line, with HMA replaced by the EMA pair (9/21 are fallbacks since no lengths are documented) and the Highest/Lowest volatility filter rendered as ATR(14) above its own average. Docs list no stops.
